plugins.name: Asteroid Expansion Pack
plugins.about: Adds 24 new asteroids and 33 new minerals throughout human space. Makes mining a little more profitable!

plugins.name: automata.destruction.0percent
plugins.about: Modifies the self destruction chance of Sestor and Mereti ships to a value of 0.0 (0%). See the README for details.

plugins.name: better.starts
plugins.about: Adds several new start options with different ships, background stories, credits and debts. See the README for details.

plugins.name: captureable.person.ships
plugins.about: Makes person ships capturable. See the README for details.

plugins.name: combat.ai
plugins.about: Offers a mission to install a combat AI, which increases your ship stats based on combat experience. See the README for details.

plugins.name: expert.crew.members
plugins.about: Adds unique crew members, aquireable through low chance spaceport missions. These crew members are technically outfits which require a bunk and a salary, but no outfit space or mass. They add, depending on their technology field, stats to your ship. Like shield regeneration, more thrust, more cargo etc. See the README for details.

plugins.name: galactic.capital.investment
plugins.about: Offers different job board banking services. From normal banking with low interest rates, over risky stock exchanges, and profitable investments (unlocked by missions), to a family trust. Available in human, quarg and hai space. See the README for details.

plugins.name: more.person.ships
plugins.about: This plugin adds more person ships to the different regions of the galaxy. See the README for details.

plugins.name: no.more.mereti.mines
plugins.about: Removes the mines from Mereti ships and replaces them with Husk-Slice and Shield Disruptor guns to increase game performance. See the README for details.

plugins.name: outfits.weapon.slot
plugins.about: Adds several non-weapon outfits for gun and turret ports. See the README for details.

plugins.name: planet.map
plugins.about: This is a storyline entirely on a planets surface(with fitting visuals). Available at the outfitter on planet Memory. See the README for details.

plugins.name: quarg.farm
plugins.about: Adds a new system 'Saquerver' (between human and coalition space) where you can farm a new Quarg faction. Also the death sentence from all other Quarg got removed. See the README for details.

plugins.name: snowfeather.robotics
plugins.about: Adds three missions that lead to adding androids to the outfitter on Snowfeather(Hai space). Starts on Snowfeather(Bore Fah) when having at least one android installed. See the README for details.

plugins.name: space.fauna
plugins.about: Adds space fauna fleets to all systems. Useless but pretty, to make the universe more alive. See the README for details.

plugins.name: uniques
plugins.about: Removes mass and outfit space from some uniques, puts others into unique category, or gives a png if there isn't one. Also adds lots of new uniques. See the README for details.

plugins.name: vague.improvements
plugins.about: A bunch of small QoL adjustment plugins. Just delete the unwanted and enjoy the wanted tweaks. See the README for details.

plugins.name: additional.command.buttons.radial
plugins.about: Reworks the main buttons ui on the lower right side. Made for the ANDROID version of ES. See the README for details.

plugins.name: automata.in.human.space
plugins.about: Brings jump drive equipped automata into human space after the wanderer campaign. See the README for details.

plugins.name: boss.loot
plugins.about: A series of dungeon-like boss encounters for a single ship. With loottables and weapon upgrade mechanism. See the README for details.

plugins.name: bunrodea.missions
plugins.about: Adds some missions and jobs to increase the Bunrodea reputation. The first mission is available after the vanilla first contact mission. Doing more jobs will allow you to get access to all their planets and ships. See the README for details.

plugins.name: coalition.shopping
plugins.about: Adds all Coalition/Heliarch/Lunarium outfits and ships to 'Far Home' in the 'Homeward' system. See the README for details.

plugins.name: comets
plugins.about: Adds 10 different comet types, as rare spawns to changing systems. These comets are minable and high profitable. See the README for details.

plugins.name: control.station
plugins.about: Adds a station to the Sol system that offers administrative functions started by the job board. See the README for details.

plugins.name: disable.person.ships
plugins.about: Disables all person ships. See the README for details.

plugins.name: disable.spaceport.repeatables
plugins.about: Disables all repeatable spaceport missions. I.e. shady passenger transport, drug smuggling, time critical transport or defend planet. See the README for details.

plugins.name: flare.play
plugins.about: Adds lots of engine flare outfits to the big shipyards and outfitters. These outfits are just cosmetic. Idea by 'Thermognuclear Missile' on discord. See the README for details.

plugins.name: fleet.mercy
plugins.about: Adds the disables personality to all fleets that do not already have it, increasing the likelihood of ships being disabled rather than destroyed during AI vs. AI combat. See the README for more details.

plugins.name: gegno.pirates
plugins.about: Adds a new faction of Gegno pirates which lets you capture Gegno ships, gain Gegno/Scin/Vi reputation, open their planets for travel, loot Gegno licenses and create an outfitter/shipyard for all their gear. See the README for details.

plugins.name: hai.side.mission.unlocker
plugins.about: Unlocks following hai missions: Unwanted Cargo Trigger, Hiding in Plain Sight, Nanachi 1,Expanding Business [1] and Hai Reveal: Pirate Troubles [0]. If there are followups they work too. Also Devil-Run related systems are shown now. See the README for details.

plugins.name: heavy.traffic
plugins.about: Offers thousands of new jobs with high cargo and passengers. See the README for details.

plugins.name: highrollers.ltd
plugins.about: This plugin adds some casino space stations where you can gamble. See the README for details.

plugins.name: human.labels
plugins.about: Reworks the Human area labels and adds area borders. See the README for details.

plugins.name: job.coloring
plugins.about: Recolors all jobs to sort them by category(cargo/passenger/escort/etc). See the README for details.

plugins.name: jump.gates
plugins.about: Adds a ring of 'jump gates' at the borders of human space to create shortcuts inside the human space. See the README for details.

plugins.name: kestrel.unlocks
plugins.about: Unlocks all Kestrel variants after you have unlocked the first one. See the README for details.

plugins.name: kor.efret.shipyard
plugins.about: Adds a shipyard with the three Kor Efret ships to Laki Nemparu(Kashikt) in Kor Efret space. Also adds an outfitter with all outfits of these three ships and some Korath Exiles outfits. See the README for details.

plugins.name: landing.images
plugins.about: Replaces all planet landing images with better fitting ones. See the README for details.

plugins.name: licenses
plugins.about: Adds several side missions to acquire unobtainable licenses. See the README for details.

plugins.name: mission.helper
plugins.about: Enables a job on every planet's job board, that shows missions you haven't done. It also shows the 'source' and 'to offer' of these missions, so you can easily find them. See the README for details.

plugins.name: more.arfectas
plugins.about: Adds the new system 'Mego Pug', in eastern Bunrodea space. There you can farm rare spawning Arfectas and other more common Pug ships, without ruining your Pug reputation. See the README for details.

plugins.name: more.boarding.missions
plugins.about: Adds lots of repeatable boarding and assisting missions for different factions. Boarding bigger ships give higher rewards or higher chances for credits or special items. See the README for details.

plugins.name: paint.your.ships
plugins.about: Offers jobs on human job boards to paint your ships. See the README for details.

plugins.name: ship.merging
plugins.about: This plugin allows you to merge several ships of the same type into one with improved attributes. This can be done several times, up to a T10 ship. See the README for details.

plugins.name: show.reputation
plugins.about: Enables a job on the Earth job board, that shows the reputation values. See the README for details.

plugins.name: too.many.asteroids
plugins.about: Removes all non-mineable asteroids from all systems. Mineable asteroids and asteroid belts are untouched. Increases game performance. See the README for details.

plugins.name: tribute.republic
plugins.about: Allows you to tribute all Republic planets, without losing Free Worlds or Deep Security reputation. See the README for details.
